nom: HBNO California Bottled Organic Rose Water for Face 4 fl oz (120ml) - USDA Certified Organic Rose Water Spray for Cleans

avis.titre: Smells amazing and works beautifully as a toner!Smells amazing and works beautifully as a toner!
avis.texte: Why I bought it: I was looking for a natural, gentle toner for daily use. My first impression: The scent is absolutely beautiful — light, fresh, and pure rose. It feels refreshing every time I spray it on. Performance after using it: I’ve been using it as a facial toner and my skin feels soft, clean, and hydrated. It helps calm redness and gives my skin a nice glow. Final thoughts: I love this rose water and will never stop using it! It’s become a staple in my skincare routine and the smell alone makes it worth it.

I don’t understand how this is so cheap and made in California, it’s a blessing. I got it at first to help with facial redness and I don’t notice a huge difference there but it’s so refreshing and smells like genuine roses. The first bottle I got was very sweet and classic rose, the second more natural. Both seem like it’s just what the flowers wanted to smell like when they turned them into spray :) my husband loves it too. It’s nice to spray on even over makeup throughout the day for a little refresh. I got one for my mom for Mother’s Day also, you can’t go wrong with rose water :)

avis.titre: Love this on my third bottle
avis.texte: OMG I don’t know if it’s this stuff or the other skin things that I’m using but my skin felt amazing. I have to use this and looked good as well. I also sprayed it in my hair. I had synthetic locs and it made them smell so good and feel so much better even looked way more realistic.

First off, this is not in a glass container, did not come with a sprayer or a booklet. I had to use my own bottle. That being said, it smells subtle and feminine, not at all like the old church ladies at a funeral. Quite lovely after the shower and before bed.
Love spritzing rose water on my face during these hot SC days

avis.titre: If everyone paid as much attention to packaging...
avis.texte: If every company paid as much attention to the packaging of their product as this company does, no one would ever complain about leaking products or broken bottles. In addition to a great smelling product, it hydrates my skin and hair. But this company's attention to detail beyond the product itself is incredible! The product comes capped to prevent leakage. It also has an outer seal. In addition, it comes with both a spray applicator and a glass dropper. Both work really well. The sprayer and dropper are in the same box as the bottle but in a separate area. There's no chance that anything will break because of the way they've packaged it. I suppose if the post office stomped on the box it could happen but it would take a great deal of effort. I'm just super impressed with both the product and the packaging, and the company itself. They rely care about happy customers! I recommend this product and the seller very highly!

avis.titre: Love this product but it’s pricey!
avis.texte: I love this product, I use it every day. I love the smell but I think it’s pricey for the size of the bottle. I typically buy 1 every month.. giving it 4 stars mainly because of the price.. but the product itself is clean and good!
Organic rose water received on time amber bottle , very secure, smell not to strong, use it for facial toner every day for refreshing.

Smells great.... but it leaked out in the box and that's how much leaked out. Look at picture. I don't know if that's a common problem or not, but I tightened the cap to test it and it leaks. Instead of 16 oz I got about 12 or 13 oz.
I am so amazed by this product. I get to indulge in the scent of roses in my everyday regime. Love the true light scent of rose and the happy it brings to my body. Please order yours.

The bottle was not sealed and was leaking. The screw top does not fit well. The total weight in the bottle is 14.43 oz. I needed this for a product to sell and can’t now because of the container not being sealed.

I love this rose water I’ve tried others in the past and this is by far my favorite. Leaves my skin glowing and moisturized. My skin did not experience any irritation. The quality of the organic rose floral water is superb. The smell is fresh and the thickness is lightweight.

I had not thought of rose water in years. While looking for skin care products, I ran across. Living in the desert, I sometimes use it either with glycerine or alone, it is a balancing act between arid and humid condition out here. This is great, it’s refreshing and smells really good. I really am enjoying this purchase.

avis.titre: Didn’t get specifically what I asked for.
avis.texte: I love this rose water but I ordered the spray for convenience and got this too instead, starting to really dislike amazon

Llego dañado y la tapa rota, lo raro es que la caja no estaba machada de producto ni mojada. No hay residuos de olor en el empaque, por lo que es como si nunca hubiera tenido producto el envase. Todo mal.

avis.titre: !Love the smell. Pretty strong rose smell. !
avis.texte: Got it today. I ordered it to use as facial toner. I was using another brand . Comparing to that it has more strong smell. Comes with dropper and Spray attachments. That’s a plus. Good price .
I liked the packaging but I’m not sure what happened I’m keeping it because I mainly wanted to use it as spray but the dropper was broken in the box
I like the subtle smell of the rose water. The spray nozzle could be better to spray like a mist not a hose spray.
I got this on March 4th: I don’t really recommend this because it’s drying on my skin after it absorbs it. Even mixing it with a sunscreen didn’t help that much. But you can use it for hair and such.
I couldn’t give this 0 star. They sent me a bottle with completely broken cap and not a single drop of rose water.

I don’t know what sort of facility would send a broken, empty bottle out as a product. I don’t trust the product manufacturers at all after this experience and will be ordering from somewhere else. Worst part is that I have to take the time to go return this empty broken bottle.

Cap arrived broken and the bottle was empty and there’s very strong perfume smell from box. Really cheap product bottle and cap and it’s claims it’s origins are Bulgaria but bottled in CA ? 2nd replacement bottle arrived the bottle must be broken bcuz again contents empty I’m not reordering from this Co. again terrible
Product was shattered on arrival. I can’t return it in this condition to get a refund or replacement.

I was so happy to place an order for Rose Water Spray. I have been using rose water spray for about a year. I love how my face feels after using the spray. I use it after cleaning my face, I use it for setting my make-up, I use it for a pick-me-up throughout the day and I also spritz it on my hair. This rose water smells divine. It smells like roses, obviously, but it is a nice light aroma and your aren't smelling a heavy rose scent after use. I have Rosacea, so this spray helps sooth my face. I especially like using it as summer approaches because it helps combat the heat. A few spritzes of the rose water provides a nice cooling sensation. I like that this product comes with both a dropper and a spray adaptor. I will most likely stay with the spray adaptor, but the dropper will allow me to fill a small spray bottle to stick in my purse so I can use the rose water spray on the go. It is a real plus that this product is organic and it is definitely not cost prohibitive.

avis.titre: I use it to freshen my hair
avis.texte: I really like the concentrated rose scent of this rose water. I use the spray attachment to apply it my hair if I can’t wash it right away after a work out. It also soothes my scalp.I’m not opposed to using it on my face. It’s just that there’s not much of it, so I ration it. It’s included, but I would never use the dropper.

HBNO Organic Rose Floral Water comes in an elegant dark bottle, featuring a user-friendly dropper and a high-quality spraying mechanism. The spraying mechanism effortlessly delivers a fine mist, while the dropper could benefit from measuring lines to enhance accuracy. As soon as this floral water touches your face, its exquisite aroma and freshness create a delightful and natural sensation. Just a few sprays are all it takes to experience a refreshing feeling that revitalizes the skin. With the included dropper, you can easily blend this rose water with various soaps, shampoos, and conditioners, infusing them with a fresh and natural twist. Aside from its immediate sensory appeal, rose water holds a multitude of uses. It can be incorporated into lip balms or used as an after-shower spray. For an exceptional experience, I recommend combining rose water with ice-cold sterile water and storing it in a sprayer bottle. This way, you can enjoy the cooling and rejuvenating effects every time you return home after being out in the sun. Among the many rose waters I've tried, this particular product unquestionably secures a spot in my top 5 favorites.

Whenever I use the serum on my skin, I prep my skin with this rose water spray followed by the serum application/massage. What it does is it helps with the better absorption of the serum. My skin feels really hydrating and plump after this prep method. Even on days when I don't use any serum, I simply spray my face/neck with the rose water spray, and my skin radiates like anything. Another thing I do to get youthful skin is use rose water with glycerin and massage it in the skin before sleeping and the next morning, my skin thank me for following that routine. This rose water is certified organic and can do wonders for the skin. Highly recommend.

I love this rose water. It smells absolutely amazing. It comes with a dropper or a spray top, but I prefer the spray top so I can spray it on my face or my hair or simply use it as I would use a perfume. I love that this is organic and only made with natural ingredients so I feel comfortable using it on my body. If you love the natural scent of roses then you will love this.

Very high quality, come with two ways of using it. As a mist, what can be better than the purest, most natural fragrance? This is simply the best. I haven’t tried to put some drops of this in my humidifier yet but I bet it would be awesome too. Also It’s a large bottle, will last a long time!

The water smells in very natural and mellow rose scent, not pungent or chemical like. Spray on cleaned face after shower and feel very refreshing and not sticky afterward. Been using it for several days already and there was no allergy reaction appears on face, seems safe for continuous use. Highly interested in trying other products from HBNO Health & Beauty.

Yes there is a typo. it if floral not loral. My face is a bit on the oily side, so after washing my face I use this Rose Floral Water as a toner. Rose water is known to have antiseptic properties, so it is a good cleanser. Comes is an glass amber bottle with a spray pump or an eye dropper dispenser. The country of origin is Bulgaria. The expiration date is 09/27/2025

The product smells delightful and feels great on my skin and hair, but I can’t use it in the way I intended to. It came with a dropper and another top that can be used in a similar way, but no spray head. If you’re buying it to use as a spray, just be aware that you might not be able to!!
You get a lot of product for the price. It’s good quality and has a good fragrance. It comes with a spray or dropper. A little bit goes a long way.

I’ve been using this daily as a makeup setting spray and room spray. Love the pure, yet subtle rose smell. It doesn’t linger for long as a perfume would, but I love that it’s not overpowering because I’m sensitive to fragrances. With daily use, this lasted me 3 months.

This is a beautiful bottle, but it smells faintly like black olives, not rose at all. I’m comparing this to Heritage Store, which also uses rose damascena. I wanted a more organic option, but they smell absolutely nothing alike I can’t believe they use the same type of rose. My toddler daughters, who love a single spritz on the face when I’m using it, both don’t like the way this spray smells either. It doesn’t expire until 2028 so I’m not sure what’s gone wrong. 2 stars for the visual esthetic.

I purchased this product to replace the Garnier SkinActive Soothing Facial Mist Rose Water with something organic and with less chemicals. Unfortunately, this product seriously dries my skin out, while the Garnier Rose Water hydrates and plumps my skin. I will be trying a different organic rose water to try and find something more suitable for my skin. So disappointing!
I use it after washing my face and as a setting spray and it just makes your skin feel so refreshing and good. And it’s amazing for your skin as well! I love it, I got my bf using it too.
This is NOT AN OIL. It is rose water. Fragrant in the bottle good for hydration and skin care.

This rose water is so refreshing and pleasant! The rose scent is just right. It’s not too heavy. Also, the packaging was very good, and it arrived very quickly. I look forward to spraying it on my face every night. It also makes your skin feel so soft and refreshed. I will definitely order again!

Heard great reviews about this rose water. I decided to give it a try. I didn’t see anything wrong until i realized the spray top is missing and it’s not inside the box where the packaging was in. I’m disappointed that wasn’t in the packaging which is the best thing about spraying rose water on your face.
It is great to spritz onto the face as a skin toner, and it smells so wonderful and feels refreshing. I use it every day during my morning routine, and love it. Includes convenient sprayer.
